description: The Medium Resolution Spectral Imager (MERSI) on FY-3C is a 20-channel optical radiometer providing multispectral imaging from visible to longwave infrared wavelengths. Its channels measure atmospheric aerosols, cloud microphysics, ocean chlorophyll, and terrestrial vegetation.
facility_description: FengYun-3C is China’s morning-orbit polar meteorological satellite in the second-generation FY-3 series, launched in September 2013 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
